name: Text to Speech Studio
summary: Type a text, pick model, voices, GPU or CPU and the voice filters, and press Speak: starts a run with those settings and shows its live progress.
help: Wire the Live telemetry of the Text to speech block (node id tts) and of the Voice filters block (node id fx) into Live progress. The button starts a run with the settings typed here. 'Re-apply filters' reruns with the same speech settings: the takes come from the worker's cache, so only the filters are computed again.
